notes:
ChunkCodec: 12-byte header (magic 56 58 43 01 | version u16 | flags u16 | sectionMask u16 | reserved u16). Each present section: paletteLen u16 | palette u16*len | bits u8 | pad u8 | data u32*n | fluid RLE (value u8, runLength u16) covering the section's 4096 voxels. bits is 0 when paletteLen===1, otherwise the smallest of {1,2,4,8,16} with 2^bits >= paletteLen; entriesPerWord = 32/bits so no entry straddles a word. Light is never stored. Block entities: count u16 then (index u16 | jsonLen u16 | utf8 json) using the parent's serializeBlockEntities / blockEntityToJson, always index-ascending. An all-air chunk encodes to 14 bytes (header + empty block entity table). ChunkCodec {version, encode, decode, canDecode} is exported as CHUNK_CODEC; decodeChunkAt(bytes, cx, cz) takes the coordinates from the storage key. blockIndex/worldToChunk/worldToLocal come from core-types and are respected by chunkLocalIndex.

WorldStore: three adapters share one payload codec and key helper set. createIndexedDbWorldStore uses compound array keys [worldId, cx, cz] (never template strings) and writes every putChunks entry in a single transaction; createMemoryWorldStore (with rawChunk/compressed for tests) and createFsWorldStore (one directory per world, chunk.<cx>.<cz>.bin, tmp+rename staging) cover Node. Compression prefers CompressionStream('deflate-raw') and falls back to node:zlib deflateRawSync/inflateRawSync for Node before 21.2; compress:false keeps payloads raw. createChunkWriteQueue batches at PERSIST.writeBatchChunks=32 or PERSIST.writeIntervalMs=1500ms, collapses repeated writes to the same chunk (latest wins), copies caller buffers, serializes flushes and flushes on close(); tests inject a manual WriteTimer so the 32-chunk and 1.5s thresholds are verified deterministically. listWorlds sorts by worldId, listChunkKeys sorts by cx then cz so negative coordinates keep their order. PlayerSave.respawn round-trips as Vec3i and as null.

RedstoneEngine: {onBlockChanged, setSourcePower, powerAt, tick(now, budget)} plus setPistonFacing/isPowered/pendingCount. Each dirty tick recomputes the whole field with a deterministic 15-down-to-1 bucket sweep (cells ordered by y,z,x), capped at min(budget, REDSTONE.maxUpdatesPerTick) and resumed on the next tick, so cyclic wire loops converge instead of oscillating. Wire loses 1 power per block from a max of 15; levers and pressure plates hold until released; buttons auto-release after REDSTONE.buttonTicks=20; doors are driven only through the parent's setDoorPowered; lamps swap REDSTONE_LAMP/REDSTONE_LAMP_LIT; pistons extend/retract REDSTONE.pistonMoveTicks=2 after the edge and push up to 12 blocks, refusing immovable blocks (piston/head, hardness<0, block entities). Stale sources whose block was mined are pruned.

Scope: packages/gameplay/src/index.ts was intentionally left untouched - persistence/index.ts and redstone/index.ts are ready for the parent to re-export at merge time. No dependency, core-types, CI, or docs/orchestration changes; fake-indexeddb ^6.2.5 was already a root devDependency and is used only by indexedDbStore.test.ts. head_sha is the commit the four final checks ran against; this report commit sits directly on top of it. Tabs, single quotes, no semicolons, import type for type-only imports throughout.
